days.title: The Blue Wave | Live in San Antonio

segs.topic: Show open with the live crowd
segs.summary: Hosts get the San Antonio audience settled and kick off the live Blue Wave show.

segs.topic: El-Sayed, outside PAC ads and Haley Stevens
segs.summary: Panel argues over whether El-Sayed has to disavow every outside PAC ad and how well he handled the fallout with Haley Stevens.

segs.topic: Senate tier list and Democratic fence-sitting
segs.summary: The panel ranks Democratic Senate candidates and debates party unity versus candidates who hedge on everything.

segs.topic: How much to trust polls and prediction markets
segs.summary: Discussion of mainstream pollsters versus betting markets, how inexact forecasting is, and whether political betting should be regulated.

segs.topic: Trump, immigration enforcement and the rule of law
segs.summary: Debate over warrants, deportation policy and how Trump-era enforcement plays with ordinary voters.
Talk about Fetterman-style candidates, Democratic media strategy and what the party should run on heading into 2028.

segs.topic: Patreon Q&A: ACA subsidies, Iran, debt and redistricting
segs.summary: Viewer questions on policy priorities, ACA tax credits, oil and Iran, paying down debt versus growth, and mid-decade redistricting.
Show ends and the hosts take photos with attendees.

segs.topic: Charity dunk tank: donors take their shots
segs.summary: Live dunk-tank bit at the San Antonio event where each donation earns a throw at the hosts; early audio trouble and lots of misses.
Thanks to the people who donated and canvassed before the stream ends.
Sound checks and banter before the day-two panel starts.

segs.topic: El-Sayed fallout: Stevens' career and the fence-sitting debate
segs.summary: Panel reacts to the latest turn in the Michigan race, argues Haley Stevens has badly damaged herself, and debates whether El-Sayed hedged too much.
Quick run through other Senate contests and how cable news is covering them.
Volunteers share door-knocking stories from Georgia, Texas and Florida, including talking with Republican voters, plus a look at El-Sayed's polling.
Technical break before the next segment.
Hosts try and rank local snacks, tortillas, burgers, pizza and ice cream.
Awards for the top canvassers and shout-outs to mods and volunteers to close out the tour stop.
